origins.neoorigins.abyssal.name: Ko te Abyssal
origins.neoorigins.abyssal.description: He mea hanga o te hohonu  he patu, he tere i roto i te wai, ā, ka taea te karanga i ngā hoa tiaki.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_water_breathing: E hemo ana i te wai i te āhua o te hau, ā, e kite mārama ana i roto i a ia, kāore he pōhēhē.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_underwater_mini: Ngā maina i te tere katoa i te wā e ruku ana.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_depth_strider.d: He tere ake te neke i roto i te wai.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.name: Te wai tuwhera
power.neoorigins.aquatic_swim_speed.desc: He kaha te kaukau i te raro o te moana, ehara i te taha noa iho.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.name: Ko te Whakatika Tuarua
power.neoorigins.aquatic_buoyancy.descri: E pupuri ana i te hohonu i te wā e takoto tonu ana, kaua ki te ruku.
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.name: Te kai ika
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet.descr: Ka taea te kai ika anake. Ka taea e ngā kaiwhakahaere tūmau te whakakore i tēnei i roto i te whirihoranga (ocean_origins.fish_diet_required).
power.neoorigins.aquatic_fish_diet_bonus: He ōrite te kai o te huka me te huka raw me ngā putanga tunu.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_aquatic_speed.d: Ka neke ia i roto i te wai me ngā nekehanga kaha, whai hua  tere ake i te tangata e noho ana i te mata.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_night_vision.de: Kua whakaritea ngā kanohi ki te pōuri tino. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.nam: Ngā Pīpī i raro i te pēhanga
power.neoorigins.abyssal_thorns_aura.des: Ka whakahokia mai te 30% o te whara i riro mai ki te hunga whakaeke.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_natural_armor.n: He kiri pakeke i te pēhanga
power.neoorigins.abyssal_underwater_mini: Ngā maina i te tere katoa ahakoa i raro i te wai.
Te Whakaora i roto i te Wai
Ka āta whakaora i te wai  tata ki te 1 HP ia 3 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_daylight_damage: He 1.5 ngā kino ia hēkona i te wā e pā ana ki te rā.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_land_speed_pena: He tangata e haere ana i te whenua
E 10% te puhoi o te nekehanga i runga i te whenua.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.name: Ka maroke
power.neoorigins.abyssal_dries_out.descr: Ka heke iho te hau i a koe i waho o te wai: ka roa rawa te mata, ka ngenge koe. Ko te ua, ko te kohua wai, ko te Waipū Waipū, ko tētahi aratohu kaha e tata ana rānei e pupuri ana i a ia.
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.name: Ko te Kaihaere Kore
origins.neoorigins.voidwalker.descriptio: Ko te tangata e pa ana ki te Whakamutunga  e haere ana i roto i ngā poraka, e mirimiri ana i ngā tawhiti poto, ā, e haere ana e kore e kitea e te nuinga o ngā whakawehi. E rere ana me te kore e ngenge, engari he mamae te wai.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_telep: Ka mirimiri ki te wāhi e titiro ana koe (tae atu ki te 24 poraka). 2 pūngao te utu. 80 ngā tohu.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_night_vision: Ka taea te kite i roto i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
E kore te tinihanga e mōhio ki tōu aroaro ki te kore koe e whakaeke i a rātau.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_water_damage: E 1 te whiu ia hēkona i te wai, i te ua rānei  e wehi ana te hau i te wai.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_no_hunger_sp: E kore e nui ake te mate kai i te tere tere.
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.name: Kaitiaki kohatu
origins.neoorigins.stoneguard.descriptio: I whanau mai i te kohatu ora  he kaitiaki e kore e taea te whakakorikori e maka ana i nga tataramoa ki runga i nga kaiwhakatuma, e keri ana i nga toka me nga ringa takitahi, e whakatakoto ana i nga rama rama ki te pouri.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_natural_armo: +3 ngā ngākau (+6 HP mōrahi). He nui ake te pupuri o te tinana kohatu i te kikokiko.
Ka whakahokia mai te 20% o te kino i riro ki ngā kaiwhakatuma.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_knockback_re: E 50 ōrau te kaha o te whakaheke.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_slow_movemen: He 10% te puhoi ake i te tangata noa.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_stone_mining: Ka rua te tere o te pakaru o ngā poraka.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_no_mob_spawn: Kāore ngā kōtiro e whakatipu i roto i ngā rohe 48.
origins.neoorigins.verdant.name: Ko te Verdant
origins.neoorigins.verdant.description: He whakaahuatanga ora o te ao matomato  kore e ngenge, i te rangimarie ki te mohoao, engari kua tino whakangaromia e te pirau o te Nether.
power.neoorigins.verdant_mobs_ignore.des: Ko ngā rōpū katoa  tae atu ki ngā rōpū hoariri  e wareware ana ki a koe ki te kore koe e whakaoho.
Ko ngā pakiaka e whakaū ana i ia hinganga. Kāore he kino o te hinganga.
power.neoorigins.verdant_no_hunger_sprin: E kore e nui ake te mate kai i te tere tere.
power.neoorigins.verdant_forest_regen.de: Ka āta whakahoutia te hauora i te wā e noho ana i roto i te ngahere.
power.neoorigins.verdant_nether_damage.d: E rua ngā whiu ia hēkona i a ia i roto i te Nether. Ka ārai rawa ngā hu o Frost Walker i te whiu.
origins.neoorigins.umbral.name: Ko te umbral
origins.neoorigins.umbral.description: Ko te tamaiti o te atarangi  e pupuhi ana i ngā ao o te pūngao pōuri, e rere ana i waenganui i ngā tūranga, ā, e whakarerekē ana i ngā pere.
power.neoorigins.umbral_night_vision.des: E kite pai ana i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.name: Ko te Shadow Dash
power.neoorigins.umbral_active_dash.desc: Ka pupuhi ki mua i te tere nui i te aronga e neke ana koe. E rua ngā pūngao. 60 ngā tīkiti.
Ka kotahi te kino i ia hēkona i te wā e pā ana ki te rā.
power.neoorigins.umbral_projectile_immun: Ka taka noa ngā pere i roto i tōu āhua i pāngia e te atarangi.
power.neoorigins.umbral_no_hunger_sprint: E kore e nui ake te mate kai i te tere tere.
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.name: Te Kōpae atarangi
power.neoorigins.umbral_shadow_orb.descr: Whakanohoia he ao matapōkere e takahi ana i te whānuitanga o te 28-block ki roto i te Pouri. Tae atu ki te 4 nga ao e kaha ana i te wa kotahi; te whakanoho i tetahi hou ka tango i te mea tawhito. 2 pūngao te utu. 60 nga wa o te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.feline_active_launch.de: Ka whiua koe e te kaha ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. E rua ngā pūngao. E whā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.name: Nga Parirau o te Rākau
power.neoorigins.draconic_flight.descrip: Ka rere noa i roto i te rangi mā te whakamahi i ngā parirau kaha.
power.neoorigins.draconic_active_firebal: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pupuhi o ngā pōro ahi iti e whā ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. E toru ngā pūngao. E whā hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.name: Te Manaakitanga o te Taiao
power.neoorigins.sylvan_crop_growth.desc: Ka tere ake te tipu o ngā hua e tata ana ki a koe, me te mea kua manaakitia e te whenua.
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.name: Te whakahiato
power.neoorigins.sylvan_active_root.desc: Whakatikahia ngā mea ora katoa e tata ana ki te wāhi ki te kaha Slowness VI mō te 4 hēkona.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_phase.d: Ka rere i roto i tētahi pakitara mārō ki te aronga e titiro ana koe. 3 hēkona whakawera.
power.neoorigins.revenant_active_bolt.de: Ka pupuhi te pūngao o te pūngao e pupuhi ana ki tētahi wāhi o te pōuri kino. Ka pau te pūngao kotahi. 4 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_starting_triden: Kua whakawhiwhia ki te toru-rangi whakamiharo kaha (Mending, Unbreaking III, Riptide III) ina whiriwhiri koe i tenei takenga mai.
power.neoorigins.abyssal_scare_ocean.des: Ka rere atu ngā mea ora o te moana  squid, fish, dolphins  i a koe i te kitenga.
power.neoorigins.voidwalker_active_phase: Ko te wāhanga puta noa i tētahi pakitara mārō i te aronga e titiro ana koe. E utu ana i te pūngao 3.
power.neoorigins.stoneguard_active_glows: Ka whakanohoia he kōhatu wherikotanga ki te mata e titiro ana koe ki a ia.
power.neoorigins.verdant_harvest_bonus.d: Mā te pakaru i ngā hua, i ngā rākau rānei, ka puta tētahi huinga atu o ngā maturuturu.
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.max_reach: Kua karangatia kē te nuinga o ngā kaitiaki!
power.neoorigins.summon_minion.not_enoug: Kāore i te nui te hiakai ki te karanga!
item.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.not_enough: Me whai koe i ngā taumata wheako %s hei whakamahi i tēnei.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Whakahokia ngā kōwhiringa taketake katoa me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa taketake. 5 ngā taumata XP mō ia whakamahinga o mua (he kore utu te whakamahinga tuatahi).
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_origin.info: Whakahokia ngā kōwhiringa taketake katoa me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa taketake. 5 ngā taumata XP mō ia whakamahinga o mua (he kore utu te whakamahinga tuatahi).
item.neoorigins.orb_of_class.not_enough_: Me whai koe i ngā taumata wheako %s hei whakamahi i tēnei.
jei.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Whakahokia mai anake tō kōwhiringa akomanga me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa akomanga, me te pupuri i tō pūtake matua. 2 ngā taumata XP ia whakamahinga. Ka pau i te whakamahinga.
emi.neoorigins.orb_of_class.info: Whakahokia mai anake tō kōwhiringa akomanga me te whakatuwhera anō i te kōwhiringa akomanga, me te pupuri i tō pūtake matua. 2 ngā taumata XP ia whakamahinga. Ka pau i te whakamahinga.
origins.neoorigins.inchling.name: Te whakahiato
origins.neoorigins.inchling.description: He tangata iti nei te rahi o te hauwhā, he māmā te piki i ngā pakitara, he tere te nekehanga  engari he tinana ngoikore e haere mai ana me te rohe.
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.name: He iti iho
power.neoorigins.inchling_size.descripti: Kotahi hauwhā noa iho o te rahi noa iho.
Ka taea e ia te piri ki ngā mata katoa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_no_fall_damage: He māmā rawa kia kore ai e mamae te hinga.
power.neoorigins.inchling_reduced_health: -5 ngā ngākau (-10 HP mōrahi). Ko te tinana hauwhā te rahi o te hauwhā o te whiu.
power.neoorigins.inchling_speed_boost.de: Ka tere ake te 15% i te mea noa.
power.neoorigins.inchling_hunger_efficie: Ka hiakai ia i te haurua o te tere o te kaitākaro noa.
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.name: Te whakaranu
origins.neoorigins.sporeling.description: He rauropi e tipu ana i roto i te pōuri, i ngā āpure rauropi  he patu ki ngā huarākau matū, engari ka maroke i te rā.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_spore_cloud.d: Ka pupuhi i tētahi pūkaha pūkaha e pupuhi ana ki roto i tētahi kapua pūkaha matū. E 3 ngā pūngao. 12 hēkona te whakawera.
power.neoorigins.sporeling_poison_immuni: He ārai ki ngā pānga katoa o te mate.
Ka āhei te kite mārama i roto i te pōuri katoa. Whakapā atu ki te kī Night Vision (K taunoa).
